# Vendored parser

| Package | Version | License | Files |
|---|---|---|---|
| acorn | 8.19.0 | MIT | `LICENSE`, `package.json`, `dist/acorn.js` |
| acorn-jsx | 5.3.2 | MIT | `LICENSE`, `package.json`, `index.js`, `xhtml.js` |

The files come unchanged from the npm tarballs (`npm pack acorn@8.19.0 acorn-jsx@5.3.2`).
`SHA256SUMS` records the files at the time of the copy. The test checks that the copy has not changed since. It does not check the files against the registry.
